advices: Tsunami may occur. Tsunami may occur in rivers as well.
If you are in the ocean, immediately get out of the water and evacuate away from the shores.
Tsunami waves are expected to hit repeatedly. Do not go near waterfronts until warning is lifted.
Return to your lodging facility and pay attention to information updates.
